description_en: Lists the tags that are attached to ApsaraDB for ClickHouse clusters
description_zh: 查询云数据库ClickHouse集群已绑定的标签列表
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type DBCLUSTER --next-token 212db86sca4384811e0b5e8707ec21345 --resource-id cc-bp1t9lbb7a4z70000 --tag Value=testvalue1 Key=testkey1 --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
>您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Set the value to **DBCLUSTER**
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query. If a query does not return all results, a NextToken value is returned. You can use this token in a subsequent query to retrieve the next page of results
parameters.help_zh: 用来返回更多结果。第一次查询不需要提供这个参数，如果一次查询没有返回全部结果，则可在后续查询中传入前一次返回的NextToken继续查询
parameters.name: next_token

element_fields.help_en:
The tag key. You can specify from 1 to **20** tag keys.

> If you specify the **ResourceId.N** parameter, you can leave this parameter empty
element_fields.help_zh:
标签键。支持同时传入N个标签键，N为整数且取值范围为**1~20**。
> 填写参数**ResourceId.N**时，该参数可以为空
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en:
The value of the tag. You can specify from 1 to **20** tag values.

> You can leave this parameter empty
element_fields.help_zh:
标签键对应的标签值。支持同时传入N个标签值，N为整数且取值范围为**1~20**。
>该参数可以为空
element_fields.name: value
